definitions.gloss: many; numerous; a great number; a multitude
definitions.explanation: A literary word meaning a large number or great quantity. More formal and poetic than たくさん.

examples.japanese: {数多|あまた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧。
{数多|あまた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a painter who left behind a great many works.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数多|あまた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受賞|じゅしょう}→受賞：11867_jushou⟧し、⟦{国際的|こくさいてき}→国際的：06457_kokusaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Having received numerous awards, she became internationally recognized.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary, elevated word. In everyday speech, ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧ or {多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ is used instead. {数多|あまた} appears in formal writing, literature, speeches, and news. Almost always modifies a noun with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {数多|あまた}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧.

NOTE ON READING:
Also read as {数多|すうた} in some compounds, but the standalone adverbial use is always あまた.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧: everyday word for "many" or "a lot"
- {数多|あまた}: literary, more emphatic
- ⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧: formal, often used for numerical majority
- ⟦{無数|むすう}→無数：00300_musuu⟧: countless, innumerable
